title: Discard-draft toast and confirm name the machine id (object/uxscratch_widget) instead of the item label
body:
**Filing gate ①**: a user-visible product defect with a named landing and a reproduction. Reach: the console Setup metadata editor, reproduced 2/2.

**Reader who acts:** the objectui metadata-admin lane seat owning `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx` and the `engine.edit.draftDiscarded` string.

## What

Discarding a metadata draft shows the toast `Draft discarded: object/uxscratch_widget`, the machine type/name, even though the item has a label ("QA Widget"). The native confirm before it reads `…for object/uxscratch_widget?` the same way.

## Reproduction (objectstack `main` `2034975a`, console pin `daeb77fc`)

1. As admin, make a draft of an object in a writable scratch package: either a Studio label rename, or `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/OBJ?mode=draft&package=PKG`.
2. Open `/_console/apps/setup/metadata/object/OBJ`.
3. Click **Discard draft** and accept the confirm.
4. Expected: the toast and the confirm name the item's label.
5. Actual: `Draft discarded: object/uxscratch_widget`.

## Mechanism

- `ResourceEditPage.tsx` calls `tFormat('engine.edit.draftDiscarded', …, { type, name })`.
- `i18n.ts` key: `'Draft discarded: {type}/{name}'`.
- Unchanged on objectui `main` `d66ceea5`. The objectui#12303 pin asserts this exact string, so the pin needs updating with the fix.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, closed included → 3 hits, none matching (by the cloud runner).

QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23953 · ux-conventions.write-feedback · clause 1
